WHERE q.is_deleted = FALSE
AND m.slug = #{slug}
AND q.chapter_id = #{chapterId}
AND q.priority IN
#{p}
AND (q.code ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR q.title ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND (sp.id IS NULL OR sp.status = 0)
AND sp.status = 1
AND sp.status = 2
AND sp.status = 3
AND sp.is_starred = TRUE
AND sp.personal_note IS NOT NULL AND sp.personal_note <> ''
mapper.select:
SELECT q.id, m.slug AS module_slug, m.title AS module_title, q.chapter_id, q.code, q.priority, q.title, COALESCE(jsonb_array_length(q.images_json), 0) AS image_count, q.has_table, q.has_code, (q.animation_key IS NOT NULL AND q.animation_key <> '') AS has_animation, q.sort_order, COALESCE(sp.status, 0) AS progress_status, COALESCE(sp.lapse_count, 0) AS lapse_count, sp.next_review_at, COALESCE(sp.is_starred, FALSE) AS is_starred, (sp.personal_note IS NOT NULL AND sp.personal_note <> '') AS has_note FROM kb_question q INNER JOIN kb_module m ON m.id = q.module_id LEFT JOIN study_progress sp ON sp.question_id = q.id AND sp.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, q.sort_order ASC, q.id ASC

SELECT q.id FROM kb_question q INNER JOIN kb_module m ON m.id = q.module_id LEFT JOIN study_progress sp ON sp.question_id = q.id AND sp.user_id = #{userId}
ORDER BY m.sort_order ASC, q.sort_order ASC, q.id ASC

SELECT module_id, COUNT(*) AS question_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'P0') AS p0_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'P1') AS p1_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'P2') AS p2_count, COALESCE(SUM(jsonb_array_length(images_json)), 0) AS image_count FROM kb_question WHERE is_deleted = FALSE GROUP BY module_id
SELECT chapter_id, COUNT(*) AS question_count FROM kb_question WHERE is_deleted = FALSE AND chapter_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY chapter_id
